description: Find U.S. Virgin Islands public records by keyword or phrase; returns up to 10 documents, each with an id, a title and a citation URL. Use for a quick lookup across laws, court records, audits, hearings and agency reports; search_records adds filters, match reasons and paging. Searches the full extracted text of the archive's documents, plus their catalogue records. Not covered: the archive's newspapers (the St. Croix Avis and every other paper the newspaper connector's list_papers names) and the Danish West Indies papers it opens for search, which are on its separate newspaper connector (the 2026 Virgin Islands Code is here, in search_code and get_code_section); and anything the archive has not published. Withheld and withdrawn documents are absent, not hidden.

query.description: What to search for. Plain language is fine; quote a phrase to require it intact.

name: search
title: Search USVI public records
